title: Water Supply, Wastewater Treatment & ZLD – EPC Equipment Support
summary: Custom equipment manufacturing and technical coordination for water supply, wastewater treatment, reuse and zero-liquid discharge projects.
equipmentScope: Custom storage tanks, process vessels, heat exchangers, evaporator-related equipment and mechanical package interfaces; project-specific scope subject to agreement.
body:
Water Infrastructure and Environmental Engineering

Tongyang supports water infrastructure and environmental EPC contractors with custom equipment manufacturing and project-specific engineering coordination. Applications include raw-water intake and transfer facilities, industrial water storage, wastewater pretreatment, water reuse and zero-liquid discharge (ZLD) systems.

Project Application Areas

  • Raw-water intake and water supply: storage tanks, process vessels and fabricated mechanical equipment for specified duties.
  • Water treatment and pretreatment: custom tanks, auxiliary equipment and mechanical interfaces for treatment packages.
  • Wastewater treatment and reuse: process equipment fabricated to approved technical specifications and system requirements.
  • Industrial wastewater and ZLD: tanks, heat exchangers, evaporator-related vessels and equipment supporting evaporation and crystallization processes.

Equipment and Engineering Support

Our equipment scope may include storage and surge tanks, pressure vessels, shell-and-tube heat exchangers, condensers, fabricated separation vessels and custom auxiliaries. Engineering collaboration can involve review of specifications, material and mechanical design coordination, manufacturing drawings, inspection planning, factory testing, documentation and delivery interfaces.

EPC Collaboration and Scope Boundaries

Tongyang can collaborate with EPC contractors, environmental engineering companies and technology providers on defined equipment packages. Process design ownership, civil works, site installation, commissioning and overall EPC responsibilities are not implied and must be established by the relevant contract.

Project References

Specific project names, capacities, supply quantities and photographs are disclosed following verification of project records and any applicable customer approvals. Please contact our team to request relevant manufacturing references for your water treatment project.
